interaccion: Sofía: I really need to **make a decision** about this new internship.
Ben: Have you **done your research** on the company culture?

inicio.definicion_pragmatica: Collocations are natural word combinations. Using 'make' vs 'do' vs 'take' correctly makes your English sound fluent and professional.

tabla.titulo: The Core Verb Collocation Matrix (Work & Study)
filas: make a decision · make an effort · make progress · make a mistake
We made great progress on the report.
do homework · do research · do business · do your best
take a break · take notes · take responsibility · take an opportunity
Please take notes during the lecture.
meet a deadline · achieve a goal · pass with flying colours · run a team

ejercicios.pregunta: Before launching the product, we must ___ thorough market research.
She had to ___ a difficult decision regarding her career.
The whole team worked overtime to ___ the Friday deadline.
If you study consistently, you will pass your exams with ___ colours.
Let's ___ a ten-minute break before continuing.

ejercicios.afirmacion: In English, we say 'make homework' rather than 'do homework'.
'Pass with flying colours' is an idiom meaning to pass an exam with exceptional results.

ejercicios.texto: It's completely normal to ___ (make / do) mistakes when learning a new language.
Don't forget to ___ (hand in / give in) your assignments by 5 PM.
The manager asked her to ___ (run / drive) the new design team.

ejercicios.respuesta: She made an effort to solve the problem
You must do research before writing

ejercicios.texto_con_error: He did a big mistake in his calculation.
ejercicios.respuesta: He made a big mistake in his calculation.

ejercicios.texto_con_error: We need to make our homework now.
ejercicios.respuesta: We need to do our homework now.

ejercicios.oracion_base: She passed the exam with the highest possible marks.
ejercicios.respuesta: She passed the exam with flying colours.

ejercicios.oracion_base: She decided to attend the international conference.
ejercicios.respuesta: She decided to take the opportunity to attend the international conference.

ejercicios.oracion_base: They made significant progress on the project.
ejercicios.instruccion: Write the sentence in the negative form.
ejercicios.respuesta: They didn't make significant progress on the project.

ejercicios.pregunta: Did you take notes during the lecture? (Short answer: Yes)
Did you make a mistake in the calculations? (Short answer: No)

guion: Sofía: The client wants us to **meet the deadline** by next Monday.
Kenji: That is very tight. We need to **make an effort** and divide the tasks today.
Ben: I can **do the research** on the background images tonight.
Sofía: Excellent! If we work together, we can **achieve our goal** without working over the weekend.
Abuela Carmen: And don't forget: an organized mind always leaves time for a cup of chamomile tea.

comprension.pregunta: What task will Ben do tonight?

reading.texto: Securing a top position in modern industries requires more than just technical qualifications. Employers actively look for candidates who can take responsibility, solve complex problems under pressure, and communicate clearly. During university, students who take every opportunity to gain practical experience and attend specialized lectures build stronger professional networks. When the final assessments arrive, those who have set clear study goals and kept consistent routines invariably pass with flying colours.

preguntas.afirmacion: Employers look for candidates who take responsibility and solve problems.
Practical experience is irrelevant for building professional networks.
Setting clear study goals helps students pass assessments with flying colours.
Attending lectures is discouraged in the text.
